default: deny

    rewriteTo: "git push --dry-run$1 # was: $&"

    action: rewrite
    rewriteFrom: ^(?<cmd>\w+) (?<rest>.*)$
    rewriteTo: $<cmd> --silent $<rest> $$ $` $' $0 $1 $9

    action: rewrite
    rewriteField: url
    rewriteFrom: "^http:"
    rewriteTo: "https:"
  - tool: Write
    action: rewrite
    rewriteField: missing
    rewriteFrom: ^
    rewriteTo: added
  - tool: Bash
    action: allow
